items.title: GLM 5.3 Flash 4-bit reported at about 102 tok/s decode on an M5 Ultra Mac Studio with TensorFold
items.summary: A builder shows Z.ai's GLM 5.3 Flash at 4-bit running on the TensorFold runtime on an Apple M5 Ultra Studio, quoting 2,100 tok/s prefill and 102.2 tok/s prose decode in a screen recording. No settings, context length or repo are given, so the numbers are a self-reported demo.
